'''Marina Aicholtz''' (Japanese: '''アイコルツ マリナ''' ''Marina Aicholtz'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

Aicholtz was born sometime on July 22, in {{wp|Nagasaki Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|JN}}, where she gained several roles, her most notable being that of [[Goh]]'s [[Rotom Phone]].
